name: JoAi: Notify Order Contact

title.fr: Notifier le contact de la commande

description.en: Send the branded order confirmation email (with invoice when available) to the customer contact for a pending order. Runs as the executing agent.
description.de: Sendet die gebrandete Bestellbestätigung (mit Rechnung, falls vorhanden) an den Kundenkontakt einer ausstehenden Bestellung. Läuft als ausführender Agent.
description.fr: Envoie l'e-mail de confirmation de commande (avec facture si disponible) au contact client d'une commande en attente. S'exécute via l'agent.
description.es: Envía el correo de confirmación del pedido (con factura si está disponible) al contacto del cliente de un pedido pendiente. Se ejecuta como el agente.
description.it: Invia l'email di conferma ordine (con fattura se disponibile) al contatto cliente di un ordine in sospeso. Eseguito come agente.
description.ro: Trimite emailul de confirmare a comenzii (cu factură dacă există) către contactul client al unei comenzi în așteptare. Rulează ca agentul executant.

bot: Use when the merchant wants to email the customer a branded order confirmation for a pending order. List orders first to resolve orderId. Prefer this over drafting a freeform contact message so the invoice PDF and shop branding stay intact. The executing agent is used as the sender.

inputs.name: Order ID

description.en: Hash ID of the order to notify about

inputs.bot: The order hash ID. List orders first if needed.

description.en: Agent UUID used as the email sender

inputs.name: Team

description.en: Team slug for this action. Defaults to the current team.

inputs.bot: The slug of the team to operate on. Omit to use the current team.
